name: make-content-two-pass-edit
description: Edits an existing draft in order: a substance pass (arguable thesis, swap test, fakes removed, CTA fit), a claims and fact check that cuts or softens unproven lines, a readability and voice-match pass, then an AI-tell sweep, with an edit note listing open gaps. Use alone when you already have a finished draft and the brand's voice samples and approved claims; otherwise run make-content.
